NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTION RULES, 2000
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER
PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTION RULES, 2000
[21st
October, 2000]
No. AO(LG)5-32/94.--In
exercise of the powers conferred by section 39 of the North-West Frontier
Province Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000, Government of the
North-West Frontier Province is pleased to make the following rules, namely.
CHAPTER - I
PRELIMINARY
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) These Rules may be called the Local Government Elections
Rules, 2000.
(2) They shall come into force at once and shall apply notwithstanding
anything to the contrary contained in any other rules on these rules unless
there is anything repugnant in the subject.
2.
Definitions .?In these rules unless there is anything repugnant in the
subject or context.
(i) "Appellate
Authority" means an appellate authority appointed under these rules.
(ii) "ballot paper"
means a ballot paper given in Forms X(A), X(B), X(C) or X(D) in the rules;
(iii) "ballot paper
account" means a ballot paper account prepared under these rules;
(iv) "candidate"
means a? person nominated for election
as member;
(v) "Contesting
candidate" means a candidate who has been validly nominated for
election as a member of a ward or as a Nazim or a Naib?-Nazim of a District,
Tehsil, Town or Union, and has not withdrawn his nomination on or before the
withdrawal day;
(vi) "council means a
Zila Council, A Tehsil Council a Town council or a Union Council constituted
under the Ordinance;
(vii) "Delimitation
Officer" means a person appointed for the delimitation of a ward of a
Union Council and includes an Assistant Delimitation Officer performing the
functions of a delimitation officer;
(viii) "electoral
roll" means electoral rolls prepared under section 18 of the
Ordinance;
(ix) "election
petition" means a petition under the Ordinance or these rules calling
an election in question;
(x) "election
tribunal" means an election tribunal appointed under the Ordinance or
these rules for the trim of an election petition;
(xi) "form"
means a form appended to these rules
(xii) "material
irregularity" means non-compliance of the provisions of these rules
which materially affect the result of an election;
(xiii) "minority
community" includes persons belonging to the Christian, Hindu, Sikh,
Buddhist and Parsi communities, a person of the Qadiani Group or the Lahori
Group (who call themselves 'Ahmadis' or by any other name) or a Bahai or any
other person who is a 'non-Muslim' as described in Article 260 of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan 1973.
(xiv) "Nomination
day" means a day appointed under these rules for the nomination of
candidates;
(xv) "Ordinance"
means the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Elections Ordinance,
2000 (N.W.F.P., Ord. No. VI of 2000);
(xvi) "Polling
agent" means a polling agent of a candidate appointed under these
rules;
(xvii) "Polling day"
means the day on which poll is taken for election of a member;
(xviii) "Polling
Officer" means a polling officer appointed under these rules;
(xix) "Polling
Station" means a premises where arrangements are made for a poll;
(xx) "Presiding
Officer" means a Presiding Officer appointed under these rules and
includes an Assistant Presiding Officer exercising powers and performing the
functions of a Presiding Officer;
(xxi) "Provincial
Election Commissioner" means the Provincial Election Commissioner,
North-West Frontier Province;
(xxii) "Publish"
includes exhibition at a prominent place accessible to the public;
(xxiii) "Returned
candidate" means a candidate who has been declared elected as a member
of a Council or a Nazim or a Naib-Nazim of a Union, Tehsil/Town or a District;
(xxiv) "Returning
Officer" means returning officer appointed under these rules and
includes Assistant Returning Officer exercising powers and performing functions
of a Returning Officer.
(xxv) "Schedule"
means a Schedule appended to these rules;
